title: Pure Dominus
summary: Pure Dominus Trap-handtrap control build pairing Dominus Impulse, Dominus Purge, and Songs of the Dominators with the Labrynth Trap engine, Lord of the Heavenly Prison, and Normal Trap staples. Each Dominus Trap can be activated directly from the hand to disrupt the opponent on Turn 0, gaining a bonus removal effect when a Trap is already in your GY.

summary.title: Dominus Handtraps & Locks
points: Dominus Impulse can be activated from the hand while the opponent controls a card to negate any card or effect that includes Special Summoning a monster (and destroy it if a Trap is in your GY); activating it from the hand locks you out of EARTH, WIND, and LIGHT monster effects for the rest of the Duel.

Dominus Purge can be activated from the hand while the opponent controls a card to negate any effect that adds a card from the Deck to the hand (and destroy it if a Trap is in your GY); activating it from the hand locks you out of DARK, WATER, and FIRE monster effects for the rest of the Duel.

Songs of the Dominators can be activated from the hand while you control no monsters to negate a face-up monster's effects on the field (and bounce a card if a Trap is in your GY); activating it from the hand locks you out of monster effects in the hand, GY, and banishment until the end of the next turn.

Infinite Impermanence serves as the fourth Normal Trap handtrap, putting a Trap into the GY early without applying Attribute locks so every subsequent Dominus Trap gets its bonus destruction or bounce.

summary.title: Opening & Turn 0 Sequence: Dominus Trap + Lady Labrynth
steps: Fire Infinite Impermanence or a Dominus Trap from your hand during the opponent's turn to negate their play and trigger Lady Labrynth of the Silver Castle in your hand to Special Summon herself.
On your turn or the opponent's turn, activate a Set Normal Trap or Trap Trick and chain Lady Labrynth's Quick Effect to Set another Normal Trap with a different name directly from the Deck.

When the opponent responds to a Normal Trap activation, Arias the Labrynth Butler revives itself from the GY, or discards itself from the hand to Set a Normal Trap that can be activated the same turn.

summary.title: Trap Recursion & Protection
summary.text: Because Lady Labrynth of the Silver Castle and Arias the Labrynth Butler are DARK Fiends, activating Dominus Impulse from the hand leaves their DARK monster effects completely live for the rest of the Duel, whereas Dominus Purge can be Set to the field first via Lady Labrynth, Trap Trick, or Lord of the Heavenly Prison so it resolves without applying its hand-activation Attribute lock. Lord of the Heavenly Prison reveals itself in hand to protect all Set cards on the field from destruction and Special Summons itself when a Set Spell or Trap is activated to Set any Dominus Trap from the Deck.

summary.title: Support Traps
points: Trap Trick banishes 1 Normal Trap from the Deck to Set another copy of the same card directly to your field, ready to activate that same turn.
Destructive Daruma Karma Cannon flips all monsters on the field face-down and forces players to send any remaining face-up monsters, including Link Monsters and unaffected towers, to the GY.
Terrors of the Overroot sends a card from the opponent's field to the GY and Sets a card from their GY in its place.

main: Dominus Impulse

Signature Normal Trap that can be activated from the hand if the opponent controls a card; negates any card or effect that includes an effect that Special Summons a monster, and destroys it if you have a Trap in your GY.
Dominus Purge

Signature Normal Trap that can be activated from the hand if the opponent controls a card; negates any effect that includes adding a card from the Deck to the hand, and destroys it if you have a Trap in your GY.
Songs of the Dominators

Signature Normal Trap that can be activated from the hand if you control no monsters; negates the effects of 1 face-up monster on the field, then bounces 1 card on the field to the hand if you have a Trap in your GY.
Lady Labrynth of the Silver Castle
Special Summons itself from the hand as a Quick Effect whenever you activate a Dominus Trap from hand or field, and sets another Dominus Trap directly from the Deck.
Arias the Labrynth Butler
Revives itself from the GY whenever the opponent responds to your Dominus Trap activation.
Lord of the Heavenly Prison
Reveals itself in hand to protect all Set cards on the field and sets any Dominus Trap directly from the Deck when a Set Spell/Trap is activated.
Infinite Impermanence
Fourth Trap handtrap alongside Impulse, Purge, and Songs to ensure you have a Trap in the GY so your Dominus Traps get their bonus destruction/bounce effects.
Trap Trick
Sets Dominus Impulse, Dominus Purge, or Songs of the Dominators directly from the Deck.
Destructive Daruma Karma Cannon
Normal Trap that clears entire boards and fuels the GY with a Trap for Dominus bonus effects.
Terrors of the Overroot
Flexible Normal Trap disruption tutorable by Lady Labrynth and Trap Trick.
